name: shang-zhu/violin
description: A video translation, dubbing, and subtitle translation skill (skill file .claude/skills/video-translator/SKILL.md) backed by a violin CLI. It translates video speech and subtitles between languages. Note: Requires user-supplied API credentials for external data access.
install: install the violin CLI, then violin --install-skill copies the skill into ~/.claude/skills/; a git clone plus uv sync plus cp .env.example .env route is also documented. Do not reproduce the README uv pipe suggestion; point to the official uv install docs or a package manager instead.
